title: Log entry envelope
description: Every log entry. Written only by kernel append. Append-only, hash-chained (bedrock rules 1, 7, 8).

kind.description: The two entry kinds. Claim kinds live in claim.schema.json.

prev.description: Hash of the previous entry; null only for 000001.

causes.description: Entries that led to this one.

hash.description: sha256 over canonical JSON of the entry without this field.
